back.es: to obtain, to get (conjugated like tener)
back.example: He/She got the job he/she wanted.

note: The gloss "achieve" in the hint leans toward lograr, but "conjugates like tener" still leaves obtener as the only answer, so the editor might tighten it to "to get, gain; conjugates like tener"; note too that everyday Latin American speech often says conseguir for "to get".
